title: [3.0-Beta5] Screen freezes when initializing Omnipod Eros
symptom: During initialization of Omnipod Eros, the screen freezes when pressing 'next' or 'OK', and Android shows 'APS does not seem to react. Close or wait?' After waiting, the pod starts clicking and the procedure completes. The issue does not occur with Omnipod Dash.
evidence_quote: After making the necessary changes and coupling the Rileylink prepared the Eros pod. Entering "Activate Pod" and pressing in the bottom on "next" nothing seemed to happen. After some time Android showed a message "APS does not seem to react. Close or wait?" I pressed "wait". At that moment the Eros started clicking, indicating the initialization procedure was started.
